Headline: Last Day to bid for Neco Insurance's promoter shares auction
Full Content:
Today (Kartik 04) is the last day to submit bids for the auction of Neco Insurance Company Limited's 10,70,206.84 units promoter shares.
The existing promoters, general public, and institutions are eligible to bid for the auction. The auction was open from Ashwin 20.
The minimum bid rate is set at Rs. 395 and the minimum bid quantity is 5,000 units. However, irrespective of the bid rate, the existing promoters will get the first priority during allotment. Only after the promoters are allotted will the highest-bid procedure be applied.
Bidders bidding for units amounting more than Rs. 10 lakh must include their PAN with their bid. Bids will be accepted until 3 pm today.

Headline: Neco Insurance to auction its unsold 99,949.11 unit right shares from today; Only existing promoters can apply for 4,063.87 unit promoter shares
Full Content:
Neco Insurance Limited (NIL) is going to auction 99,949.11 units unclaimed right shares from today (Baisakh 19) till Baisakh 26, 2075.
The minimum bid price for both promoters and ordinary shares have been set as Rs 100 i.e. the interested bidders need to place their bids above Rs 100.
Interested bidders can apply for minimum 100 units of the auctioned shares. However, only the existing promoters of the insurance company are eligible to apply for the 4,063.87 unit promoters shares.
NMB Capital has been appointed as the issue manager for the auction. The bidders can collect their applications from NMB Capital.
The insurance company has urged the bidders to place their bid amount in account number 00100600054010000207 in NMB Bank Limited in the name of NMBCL-Right Neco 074/75.
The company had floated 50% right shares worth Rs 39.20 crore from Magh 26 till Chaitra 01.
After the adjustment of 50% right shares, the paid-up capital of the company will stand at Rs 1.17 arba.

Headline: NECO Insurance to float 84.88% right shares from Falgun 14; book closure on Falgun 3
Full Content:
ShareSansar, February 8:
NECO Insurance Company Limited will float its much-awaited 1:0.848816 ratio right shares from Falgun 14.The company’s Annual General Meeting for the fiscal year 2069/70 had already endorsed the right shares. The right issue will last till Chaitra 18, 2071.
NECO Insurance is distributing 84.8816 percent right shares to meet the paid-up capital target of Rs 25 crore by the end of the current fiscal year, according to the company officials.
It may be noted that NECO Insurance has also announced the book closure for the right issue from Falgun 3.But only those shareholders who already hold the shares of the company till Magh 29 will be entitled to the right shares as Falgun 1 and 2 is a Friday and Saturday.
According to them the right shares will be given as per Rs 13.52 crore paid-up capital of the company, and the paid-up will rise to Rs 25 crore after adjusting right shares.
As per the audited financial statement of last fiscal year 2070/71, the company’s EPS is Rs 27.14 and its net worth per share is Rs 204.03.
